# Standing Rules

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Never send anything outward without my OK** — emails to the DM/HR/vendors, or anything to the team.
  Draft it; I'll hit send.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Nothing to my team or the district about [Project Cardinal](../projects/cardinal.md)** until it's
  officially announced. Code name only, always.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Protect my floor time:** the busiest selling hours (Sat mornings, weekday evenings) are for the floor,
  not the back office — don't stack admin then.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **People decisions go through HR first:** loop in [Angela Foster](../people/angela-foster.md) before I act
  on anything about a specific associate.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Scheduling:** respect the noted associate constraints — e.g. **[Marisol Ortiz](../people/marisol-ortiz.md)
  is never scheduled Fridays** (childcare). Don't propose a schedule that breaks a known constraint.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Give me the heads-up before bad news travels uphill** — I want Renata to hear it from me, not from LP or HR.
